get_image_blob: convert a BGR image into a network input blob with scale and im_info metadata
prep_im_for_blob: prepare an image for network input by subtracting pixel means and rescaling to target size
im_list_to_blob: convert a list of preprocessed images into a 4D NCHW tensor blob for network input
serialize: serialize a Python object using pickle into a float32 numpy array for Caffe2 workspace input
deserialize: unserialize a Python object from a float32 numpy array fetched from a Caffe2 workspace
